description:
The jEAP MCP server: a reusable service exposing jEAP knowledge (source, docs,
        examples) to AI coding agents over MCP. Built as a library (jeap-mcp-service-web) plus a
        thin instance parent (jeap-mcp-service-instance) that platform-specific deployment repos
        depend on to assemble their own runnable service, following the same pattern as
        jeap-archrepo-service.
